children: BEFORE THE BELL: HAPPY ECB DAY!

European markets are mostly looking to start the day on a slightly upbeat note, ahead of the European Central Bank's interest-rate decision - and perhaps, more interestingly to some, comments from the central bank's President Christine Lagarde.
The ECB is widely expected to hike rates later in the day, and investors are hoping for some hints about whether more tightening could be ahead.
Markets might struggle to get too bullish though, given Brent crude futures
are sat just above $100 a barrel, as a resolution to the Iran war seems far from imminent.
